svg.title: LSM compaction merge step — ride-share driver location example
svg.desc: Three input SSTables hold pings of active driver locations encoded as geohashes. A k-way merge keeps the most recent ping per driver, drops stale positions, and removes drivers who have gone off shift. The output is the live driver state that the dispatch system queries when matching riders to nearby drivers.
svg.text: key = driver:id · value = geohash · seq# rises with each ping
newest seq# wins; tombstones drop drivers who went off shift
Output SST — live driver state for dispatch
